synopsis: The booklet identifies AS 21815.1:2023 as Standards Australia's modified (MOD) adoption of ISO 21815-1:2022, bringing that framework into the Australian standards system [f2259, f15027, f15534]. However, the booklet did not locate its Standards Australia catalogue entry and could not read the modifications, leaving the Australian changes unverified [f2873, f15156]. Standards Australia also published the communication-interface specification SA TS ISO 21815.2:2023, which is listed on its store; neither it nor AS 21815.1:2023 is law unless incorporated [f15157, f2874]. The glossary additionally records Standards Australia's adoption of ISO 16001 as AS ISO 16001:2020 [f15535].
